data.summary:
Certified Product Manager and Product Owner with 14 years of experience in Agile product
development. Skilled in product strategy, roadmap planning, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions. Strong expertise in product discovery, backlog ownership, stakeholder management, and value-driven delivery. Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, customer-centric products. Brings domain experience across banking (investment banking – capital markets), audit, US healthcare and enterprise platforms, with a focus on compliance and user- focused innovation.

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Deloitte, Technical Product Manager
02/2020 – Present | Hyderabad
▪ Gather and analyze business requirements, owning & managing the product backlog aligned to business objectives & strategic priorities, serving as liaison between business stakeholders & technical teams
▪ Define product scope & roadmap across 6+ product versions, ensuring
alignment with stakeholder expectations & organizational goals.
▪ Translate business requirements into clear epics, features & user stories (BDD)
in GHERKIN methodology.
format using Behavior Driven Development
▪ Lead product discovery sessions, requirement workshops, story mapping exercises, & backlog refinement with business & technology stakeholders using MoSCoW prioritization technique.
▪ Collaborate with UX, architecture, & engineering teams to validate
solution designs & ensure feasibility.
▪ Lead the definition and delivery of AI-powered product capabilities, translating business problems into AI use cases, product requirements, epics, features, user stories and measurable acceptance criteria.
▪ Partner with AI/engineering and architecture teams to evaluate AI solution approaches, validate technical feasibility, define functional requirements and integrate intelligent capabilities into enterprise product workflows.
▪ Drive adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI and RAG-based capabilities to improve automation, decision support, information retrieval and user experience across enterprise platforms.
▪ Define AI product requirements covering LLM-driven workflows, prompt engineering, RAG
processes including chunking, embedding and retrieval, intelligent automation and AI-assisted decision-making.
▪ Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to support Azure-based product delivery and Azure DevOps, including backlog management, sprint planning, work-item tracking, release coordination, dependency management and delivery governance.
▪ Leverage Azure DevOps for product backlog ownership, epic/feature decomposition, user-story management, sprint execution, release tracking, defect management and visibility of delivery progress across distributed Agile teams.
▪ Use Azure DevOps dashboards and delivery metrics to monitor sprint progress, identify
blockers and dependencies, track release readiness and provide delivery visibility to business and technical stakeholders.
▪ Lead Agile Scrum framework implementation, facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, & retrospectives, ensuring readiness & clarity of backlog items.
▪ Drive end-to-end delivery ownership from ideation through development, UAT, & release, successfully delivering 6+ major product releases ensuring on-time delivery & stakeholder satisfaction.
▪
Program Increment (PI) demos & progress updates to 60+ senior stakeholders & technical team members, incorporating feedback into future iterations.
▪ Cloud data platforms & complying to best practices in data engineering
▪
Translate US Healthcare business and operational requirements into product roadmaps, epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment with business objectives and healthcare stakeholder needs.
▪ Collaborate with business, technology, architecture and engineering stakeholders to define and
deliver healthcare-focused digital and AI product capabilities, balancing business value, technical feasibility, user experience and compliance requirements. ▪ Lead AI product capabilities and development, collaborating with engineering teams to define AI-driven features, leverage predictive insights, and integrate intelligent automation into product workflows.
▪ Ensure solutions comply with data privacy,regulatory, & enterprise governance standards, especially relevant to financial, audit & US healthcare platforms.
